title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.23835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show that the draft's whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target's vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup hold

translated_title: NarrowSpec：推测解码中草稿模型的隐藏宽度无需与目标模型匹配
translated_abstract: 推测解码被广泛用于加速大语言模型（LLM）的生成，其方式是由一个小型草稿模型提出候选token，再由目标模型的一次前向传播进行验证。读取目标模型隐藏状态的草稿模型（如DFlash和EAGLE-3）通常继承目标模型的隐藏宽度。我们证明，草稿模型的整个残差流可以在该宽度的一半或四分之一下运行，同时基本保持token接受率。对于借用目标模型词表投影的DFlash，训练得到的输出适配器可以折叠进该投影中，形成一个更窄的投影，其logits在浮点舍入误差范围内保持不变。我们在SGLang中，于B200和DGX Spark（GB10）硬件上，针对两个目标模型Qwen3-8B（NVFP4）和GPT-OSS-20B（MXFP4），测试了DFlash和EAGLE-3两个草稿模型系列。在批量大小为1、温度为0的条件下，将草稿模型收窄至一半或四分之一宽度，可使端到端解码在B200上提速1.06-1.12倍，在GB10上提速1.13-1.44倍。该加速效果……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出NarrowSpec，证明推测解码中读取目标隐藏状态的草稿模型的隐藏宽度可缩小至目标模型的一半或四分之一而几乎不影响接受率，从而在B200和DGX Spark上实现1.06-1.44倍的端到端解码加速。
en_tdlr: NarrowSpec demonstrates that in speculative decoding, the draft model's hidden width can be reduced to half or a quarter of the target's while largely preserving acceptance, yielding 1.06-1.44x end-to-end decoding speedups across DFlash and EAGLE-3 drafters on B200 and DGX Spark hardware.
